# SelfOrganizedOscillatoryLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning paradigm where oscillator phase relationships and coupling strengths self-adjust without external supervision, driven by local memristive dynamics and network topology. Provides a biologically inspired, decentralized alternative to backpropagation, suitable for energy-efficient in-network neuromorphic computation.
